outputs.prompt: Create ONE landscape 16:9 illustrated whole Adventure level art-direction mockup for Lumia Chronicles. Reference images 1 stone planter, 2 glass/brass arch, 3 sage plant are authoritative existing asset materials, palette and soft hand-painted watercolor/pencil rendering. This is a LARGE traversable botanical exploration world seen in elevated orthographic 2.5D three-quarter overhead view, roof hidden, entire multi-screen level visible, no horizon, no vanishing point. Not a Life-mode dialogue background. Warm lyrical academic classic fantasy: cream limestone modular paving, muted sage foliage, ivy, gentle apricot flowers, restrained antique brass, tiny turquoise rune highlights, matte painted surfaces, warm diffuse daylight. Match references closely; no photorealism, plastic 3D, neon, pixel art, flat colored rectangular blockout, giant palace. Coherent modest greenhouse garden level: lower-center entrance through reference-style glazed arch; branching stone paths lead to a central quiet courtyard; west investigation garden with ONE wilted planter, east moon-herb garden with THREE blue-green collectible herb clusters, north small rune clearing containing one dim rune stone; a small optional garden alcove west. Paths create readable connected exploration routes and gentle loops, 3-4 character widths, corners and fork junctions visible. Dense but controlled planted borders and flower beds integrate soil into paving without exposed cutout roots. Natural planted islands, not six empty square rooms. Repeatable modular stone/edge pieces and separately placeable plant/arch silhouettes should be visually understandable as a tile-assembled level. No disconnected floating islands, no major stairs or bridges. Same scale across map, no huge buildings, only two or three arches, translucent greenhouse wall fragments at far perimeter leave interior visible. About 3 screens wide by 3 screens high; close gameplay camera will later show only east herb garden, not whole map. No characters, HUD, labels, text, grid overlays, diagrams or margins. Beautiful finished concept art, playable-looking walkable negative space and layered foreground plants, never overdecorated. Output one 1920x1080 image if supported.
